name: Ranch Hand Trail Stop "Ranchers Omelet" (Ham, Swiss & Cheddar Mod)
whyItWorks: Fluffy three-egg omelet folded with diced ham and naturally low-lactose Swiss cheese paired with white or sourdough toast is a high-protein stop along US-89.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ranchers Omelet with ham and Swiss/cheddar only (hold the greasy sausage links if sensitive to spice/fat) and pair with white or sourdough toast.
watchOuts: Ordering all three meats (ham, bacon, sausage) plus American cheese makes it high in fat—stick to ham & Swiss during recovery
